artworks.title: The Ecstasy of Saint Paul
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated with a full beard and balding head. He is wearing draped clothing that exposes part of his shoulder. He is seated towards the lower left of the image, facing to the right, with one arm raised. He holds a staff in one hand, with open books scattered around him. There are ethereal, winged figures with delicate features and flowing hair surrounding him. These figures are mostly torso, arms, and heads, with one playing a musical instrument. Above them float more winged cherubs among the clouds. The background is filled with clouds, creating a celestial atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Seven Planets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures amidst clouds. The composition includes figures engaged in interaction within a cloudscape. The central figure holds a shield and gestures towards another seated figure. Celestial entities are depicted above in flowing poses. The scene features creatures and emblems of mythology like wings. The line work and cross-hatching create depth and texture, enveloping the scene in an ethereal atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: etching with roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three main figures and part of a fourth being in a dynamic and illustrated setting. There is a woman with a serene expression wearing a head covering, seated or partially reclining, holding an infant child. The child has curly hair and a slightly turned body. To the right, the back of a male figure is visible, with curly hair and possibly a beard, appearing to write or sketch. Above them, a small winged figure with curly hair is seen amidst cloud designs. The background is detailed with clouds and lines, giving a sense of depth and sky.

artworks.title: A Philosopher
artworks.description: The image shows a bust view of a person, depicted from the shoulders up. The individual is positioned in a three-quarter view, with their head turned slightly to the left. The person has an aged appearance with a furrowed brow, a pronounced nose, and flowing hair that is full and slightly unkempt, cascading down over the forehead and ears. Their facial hair includes a full beard, which blends into the longer hair. The person is wearing a loose-fitting, long-sleeved garment. They are leaning on a flat surface, likely a book or manuscript. The background consists of dense cross-hatching and lines, suggesting a textured or patterned wall behind the figure, with some angled structural beams overhead.

artworks.title: Pietà
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. In the center, a person lies down with their head tilted back. They have closed eyes, a slightly open mouth, short wavy hair, and a draped cloth over part of their lower body. Another person sits behind them and a third person lies near the central figure's feet. The second person has long hair, wears draped clothing, and looks downward. The background features textured or rocky surfaces. The engraving is signed "Paulus Troger in: fecit" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Tobias Healing His Father
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals, mainly focusing on their upper bodies. The central figure is seated and leaning back, with their head tilted upwards and appearing elderly with a beard. Two other figures are surrounding the central person; one standing to the left with an outstretched arm and the other to the right with less detailed features and wavy hair. A person is holding a cloth or garment around the waist area of the central figure. The figure to the right is holding a stick or staff. The clothing on these figures is draped and flowing, suggesting classic or historical attire. The background includes architectural elements like columns and a structure with a dome, as well as sparse natural elements like trees and clouds, creating a complex setting typical of classical or mythological themes.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Drawing
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated person leaning slightly forward. They have long, wavy hair, a prominent nose, and discernible facial features. The person is wearing a long-sleeved garment, with slightly crumpled sleeves. They are holding a quill pen or similar writing instrument and focused on a surface. The background has a linear, textured pattern, and there is elaborate script or decoration at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Four Saints
artworks.artist: Johann Beheim after Franz Anton Maulbertsch
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene. The intricate work features figures in various attire, some holding staffs or branches. An infant-like figure sits atop a sphere emitting a radiant glow. Angelic beings are also depicted, reinforcing a celestial theme. Architectural elements like columns and clouds are included, blending into the background. The composition of figures and objects guides the viewer's eye around the piece. The artwork balances light and shadow to create a complex interplay.

artworks.title: A Battle between Oriental Cavalry and Soldiers
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a battle scene. The drawing shows a conflict between an armored figure on horseback and another figure standing and holding a sword as they appear to engage in combat. The horses are depicted in dynamic poses, adding a sense of movement to the scene. The background features energetic lines, enhancing the overall sense of motion. Detailed lines show the muscles and movement of the horses, as well as the flowing garments of the figures, emphasizing the dramatic intensity of the moment. The composition freezes a dynamic moment, conveying urgency and action.

artworks.title: The Georgenberg in the Tyrol
artworks.artist: Johann Christoph Erhard and Johann Adam Klein
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white etching of a mountainous landscape. The viewpoint is panoramic, capturing a rugged terrain with mountains in the far distance. A building sits on a rocky cliff near the top of the composition, overlooking the scene. The etching depicts fine details in trees and foliage, textured marks outlining cliffs, and hills. Cows graze in the lower section, with a person among them. A wooded area extends into valleys and hills. The black and white palette accentuates the details of nature and human structures. An arched bridge is visible on the right side, connecting the landscape.

artworks.title: Without Ceres and Bacchus, Venus Freezes
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene featuring a group of figures by a fountain. The image depicts several figures gathered around a circular basin, with a central fountain that appears to be adorned with sculptural figures. A standing figure in the foreground is holding a wine glass, possibly engaged in a conversation with another figure who is seated. There is a sense of interaction and merriment among the figures, as suggested by their gestures and the convivial arrangement. The composition is enriched with intricate details such as flowing drapery and sculptural elements on the fountain, along with architectural features like columns and arches in the background. The drawing has a classical aesthetic.

artworks.title: The Herdsman's Cottage
artworks.description: The image features a woman standing next to an animal near a stream in a forest. Tall trees with sprawling branches and dense foliage dominate the scene. The sun is visible through the foliage, casting light beams across the image. The artwork is detailed with fine-lined etching showing textures of figures and landscape, utilizing cross-hatching for contrast between light and shadow. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing light and shadow play in a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Prospettiva della Scala della conserva d'acqua de' già detti alloggiamenti, accennati in pianta nella Tav. XIII con la lett. G.
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with a staircase. The scene features a stone edifice with a staircase ascending into an arched opening. The stone texture is detailed with hatching and cross-hatching. Light and shadow play a role in the composition. The staircase is prominent, leading the eye upward. Archways and stone details hint at historical significance. Foliage and moss add to the sense of age and decay in the scene.

artworks.title: Panoramic Views of Vesuvius and Monte Pellegrino
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon cuts through the center, showcasing large mountains in purples and grays. Above, the sky is vast with blue and gray clouds. The sky's brushstrokes are fluid, creating a sense of movement. The color palette is muted, with soft grays, purples, and blues creating a serene atmosphere. Below the horizon, the land is lightly sketched with trees, shrubs, and possible structures or rocks.

artworks.title: Views of Monte Pellegrino
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a landscape. The horizon is visible in the upper half of the composition, dividing the sky and ground. There are sketchy lines indicating clouds on the horizon. The drawing features loose pencil strokes, creating a delicate appearance. The landscape includes shrubs, trees, and distant vegetation. The color palette is grayscale, with various tones created by the pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Une Matinée d'Hiver au Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu (Winter Morning on the Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image depicts a city street with buildings and pedestrians. The composition shows a road with buildings in the background. Some smoke rises from chimneys aligned with the building roofs. The detailed linear style suggests a misty atmosphere, likely created through etching or engraving. The monochrome grey color scheme adds to the somber mood, with reflections hinting at rain. Horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians with umbrellas are in motion on the street. The buildings on the right show vertical and horizontal lines for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Environs de Dordrecht
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image depicts a river scene with a sailboat sailing to the right. In the distance, windmills can be seen along the horizon. The etching shows delicate brushstrokes that capture details of clouds and water ripples. The color palette is monochrome with shades of brown and beige.

artworks.title: Le Pavillion de Mlle. et une partie du Louvre
artworks.artist: Charles Meryon after Reinier Nooms, called Zeeman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene from an elevated position. The horizon is in the top third of the image, featuring buildings and a bridge across the river. Close to us are small boats along the riverbank, with figures engaging in various activities. The boats and figures are depicted with detailed line work, typical of etching. On the right, a prominent building with intricate architecture adds depth to the composition. The color palette is limited to sepia tones, emphasizing the contrast between the etched lines and the paper's natural hue. In the distance, there are softer lines and lighter shades suggesting hills and structures receding into the background.

artworks.title: Catafalque
artworks.artist: Johann Andreas Pfeffel I after Giuseppe Galli Bibiena
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural structure with elaborate detailing. The image features a large structure with symmetrical classical columns supporting an ornate upper balcony, crowned with decorative statues and intricate carvings. The structure is divided down the middle, presenting a detailed depiction on one side and a partially unfinished sketch on the other, highlighting the process of architectural drawing. The overall composition is rich with architectural elements such as obelisks and statues, portraying an elaborate and grandiose architectural design.

artworks.title: The Noon Recess
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classroom scene with a woman and a child. The image shows an interior of a classroom where a woman is sitting on a bench next to a child who is reading a book. The woman is leaning on her arm on a desk cluttered with books and school materials. A school bell is on the desk. A map of the United States is on the wall behind the woman. Through two windows, scenes of children playing outdoors can be seen. A blackboard with the alphabet and numbers is visible in the background, along with some books and school supplies on another bench. Wooden floors add to the setting's nostalgic feel.

artworks.title: The Temple of Vesta
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape view with a low horizon line. The horizon is marked by a distant mountain range. To the left, an old stone building with rounded arches is perched on a small hill. Below the building is a river or stream. The scene features intricate linear brushstrokes portraying stonework, foliage, and water. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia. Closest to us, two figures on horseback are guiding cattle across the shallow waters. In the background, trees and a mountain range are visible, giving a sense of scale and depth.

artworks.title: Vue d'Aqua Pendente sur la route de Sienne a Rome
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a riverside scene viewed from an elevated position looking slightly downward, capturing both land and water. The horizon is placed relatively high, allowing a clear view of undulating hills and a distant village with structures atop them, including what appears to be a castle or fort. To the left, a winding path leads up a hill towards a cluster of buildings perched near the edge, with several figures making their way along the path. Close to us, on the path, are two women engaged in conversation, while another person nearby walks up the slope. In the water below, there are several small boats with billowing sails and figures tending to them. Behind the boats lies a calm river, bordered by dense trees and low hills. The etching exhibits finely detailed line work that provides texture to the landscape, with the shading skillfully portraying depth and dimension. The overall color palette is monochromatic, utilizing various shades of sepia, which adds a historical and timeless quality to the scene. The sky is lightly etched with soft clouds.

artworks.title: Moonlit Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with a horizon at dusk or dawn. The horizon divides the composition, with a focus on the light where the sun meets the water. The light source is centrally positioned, drawing the eye towards it. The landscape includes a waterbody reflecting the light, with tree silhouettes framing the scene on either side. The artwork uses a pointillist technique with stippling brushstrokes creating a textured sky. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and beige, enhancing the tranquil atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Abandoned Village
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gaillard F. Ravenel and Frances P. Smyth-Ravenel
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a riverbank, ancient structures, trees, ruins, foliage, and a calm body of water. The scene is depicted in an etching style with intricate lines and hatching, utilizing a monochromatic color palette of greys and blacks.
